'''''Legacy of the Force: Inferno''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel and the sixth volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series. It was written by [[Troy Denning]] and published by [[Del Rey]] in paperback on [[August 28]], [[2007]], while the [[Science Fiction Book Club]] released an exclusive hardcover edition. The book includes a bonus interview on the creation of the ''Legacy of the Force'' series.
